resources.string: Aap ise kabhi bhi Settings mein badal sakte hain.
Arre! Kya tum mujhe details bhej sakte ho?
Zaroor, voice note bhej raha hoon 🎙️
Yeh bubble WhatsApp ke upar float karta hai. WhatsApp chhodte hi yeh gayab ho jata hai.
Record karne ke liye dabakar rakhein
Ab aapki baari! Chamakte mic ko kuch second dabakar rakhein.
Recording ho rahi hai… dabakar rakhein
Ungli hatayein. AuraMic aapke phone par hi background noise hatata hai aur voice note khud bhej deta hai.
Cancel karne ke liye left slide karein
Mann badal gaya? Dabaye rakhte hue button ko left sarkayein aur chhod dein. Kuch nahi bheja jayega.
Button ko tezi se kheenchkar kahin bhi rakhein. Yeh paas ke kinare se chipak jata hai aur jagah yaad rakhta hai.
Kuch zaroori permissions se yeh kaam karta hai. Sab kuch aapke phone par hi rehta hai.
Android sahi settings page kholega; AuraMic ko on karke wapas aayein. Hum yahan tick laga denge.
Yeh aapka voice note saaf hone ke baad WhatsApp mein Send dabata hai.
Kuch permissions isse kaam karne deti hain. Aapki audio kabhi phone se bahar nahi jati.
WhatsApp ke upar mic bubble dikhata hai.
Button dabane tak aapki awaaz record karta hai.
Pata chale ki WhatsApp khula hai
Taaki mic sirf WhatsApp ke andar dikhe. Android ise “Usage access” kehta hai.
Voice note saaf hone par aapke liye Send dabata hai. Android ise “Accessibility” kehta hai.
AuraMic ko background mein bharosemand dhang se chalane ke liye zaroori.
Android ko AuraMic sulane se rokta hai. Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung par recommended.
Play Store ke bahar se install kiye apps ke liye Android ise rokta hai. App info kholein, ⋮ menu dabayein, “Allow restricted settings” chunein, phir dobara try karein.

AuraMic Accessibility Service ka use sirf ek kaam ke liye karta hai: voice note record karne ke baad aap jis chat mein the use chunna aur WhatsApp ya WhatsApp Business ke andar Send button dabana, taaki note bina extra tap ke bhej diya jaye.

Yeh sirf WhatsApp aur WhatsApp Business mein kaam karti hai. Yeh aapke messages, contacts ya koi personal data na padhti hai, na store karti hai, na share karti hai. Audio aapke device par hi process hoti hai.

Mic ko WhatsApp ke voice button par rakhne aur typing ke time hatane ke liye yeh sirf dekhti hai ki wo button kahan hai aur message box khali hai ya nahi. Aap jo type karte ho use kabhi nahi padhti.

Yeh screen par WhatsApp ke apne voice button ki jagah bhi dekhta hai, taaki AuraMic ka mic theek uske upar baithe. Yeh message ka text kabhi nahi padhta.
WhatsApp kholein — aapka floating mic tayyar hai.
WhatsApp mein floating mic dikhane ke liye on karein.
Shuru karne ke liye permissions poori karein.
Is phone mein WhatsApp install nahi hai.
Shor wala sample record karein aur pehle / baad sunein.
Button dabayein aur shor wali jagah bolein. Phir compare karein.
Recording ho rahi hai… khatam karne ke liye chhodein
Aapki audio saaf ho rahi hai…
Bahut chhota — thoda aur der dabayein.
Voice note saaf hote hi apne-aap bhej deta hai.
Record ke liye daba ke rakhein · move karne ke liye 3 baar tap
Bhej nahi saka — Send khud dabayein
Move mode: mic ko kahin bhi khichein. Wapas fix karne ke liye 3 baar tap karein
Mic WhatsApp ke button par fix
Record ke liye daba ke rakhein · WhatsApp mic par fix ke liye 3 baar tap
Shayad bhej diya — chat check kar lein
WhatsApp khulne par floating mic dikhta hai.
Android ne ise rok diya. Wapas on karne ke liye tap karein.
Koi permission band ho gayi. Theek karne ke liye tap karein.

Floating mic se voice note record karne ke baad AuraMic WhatsApp mein Send button dabata hai. Yeh sirf WhatsApp ke andar kaam karta hai aur aapke messages kabhi nahi padhta ya save karta. Yeh WhatsApp ka voice button bhi dhoondhta hai taaki AuraMic ka mic uske upar baithe.

Tez aur halka. Pankhe, traffic aur kamre ki goonj jaisa zyada tar background shor hatata hai aur aapki awaaz saaf rakhta hai. Voice note turant ready hota hai aur battery kam kharch hoti hai. Roz ki chat ke liye badhiya.

Studio jaisi saaf awaaz. Lagbhag sara background shor hata deta hai, paas mein bolte logon ki awaaz bhi, aur aapki awaaz ko bhari-puri, balanced aur kaafi tez banata hai, bilkul professional podcast jaisi. Kuch second zyada lagte hain aur battery thodi zyada kharch hoti hai.
%1$d free High Quality voice note bache hain
Aapke free High Quality note khatam ho gaye. Chalate rehne ke liye Pro lein.
Pro active hai — High Quality unlock hai.
Har baar studio jaise saaf voice note.
Har voice note par High Quality safai
Aapki awaaz bhari-puri, saaf aur professional lagti hai
Poori tarah offline — aapki awaaz phone se bahar nahi jaati
Google Play mein kabhi bhi cancel karein
Free Medium Quality ke saath chalu rakhein
Google Play abhi available nahi hai. Internet check karke dobara try karein.
0.3 second se lambi chuppi kaat deta hai, taaki voice note chhota aur tight rahe.
Google Play mein cancel karne tak apne-aap renew hota hai.
Original aur saaf audio save karein
Har voice note ke dono version Studio Lab mein dikhenge. Sirf isi phone par save (%1$s).
Abhi koi saved voice note nahi. Floating mic se ek bhejein, dono version yahan dikhenge.
Save karna band hai. Naye notes yahan rakhne ke liye Settings mein “Original aur saaf audio save karein” on karein.
Yeh recording play nahi ho sakti
Saare saved voice notes delete karein?
Original aur saaf recording is phone se hat jayegi. WhatsApp mein bheje gaye notes wahin rahenge.
Ek chalte waqt doosra version tap karein, usi jagah se switch ho jayega.
Saaf karte waqt gadbad hui. Dobara koshish karein.
